reason: E3 and E4 show that Mn eliminates the fcc-hcp energy difference via magnetic frustration in the quinary, and that CrCoNi (Mn-free) undergoes fcc-to-hcp transformation, directly contradicting the premise that Mn is required for or promotes this transformation. The cited evidence does not support the claimed link between Mn, lower SFE, and enhanced twinning/transformation relative to Mn-free variants.
premises: Mn induces magnetic frustration in Cr-Mn-Fe-Co-Ni
Magnetic frustration lowers effective stacking fault energy (SFE)
Lower SFE triggers fcc-to-hcp phase transformation
Reducing/removing Mn increases SFE and suppresses twinning/transformation
